meta.name: QQ Coffee · the site system
meta.title: One fluid size system for the whole site; round 7: one menu cell for the filters and the buy bar, a catalog that deals its cards, a pack that follows the scroll and the hand
meta.lede: The whole system of the QQ Coffee site: 36 size roles drawn as lines from a 320 to a 1440 screen, three shared layout steps and the column at its most, one colour table with one line colour, one motion vocabulary, the 3D packs. Round 7 answers your comments on the catalog, the product page and «О компании»: the info blocks level at the top, tabs at 30% trimmed to their capitals, the filters and the buy bar's options as one menu cell whose list continues it, cards rising one after another, photos only for Special coffees, no line above the footer; the pack exactly with the scroll and draggable, the buy bar black, even room around «Кофе с похожим вкусом»; the team of fourteen. Measured at every 10px of width and 25px of height and at 25 real screens; «before» is round 6's build (main).
meta.footer: Measured in headless Chromium on the built sites, 2026-10-21. Before = round 6 (main, commit fb442f2); now = branch claude/dreamy-dirac-bwl5jb. Earlier rounds compared with their own previous builds (round 1 with the Figma frames).

items.title: The catalog's head (1440)
items.text: From M one row, the tops level as before; the inactive tabs at 30%; the chevrons at 30%; «Цена».

items.title: A filter open, its option hovered (1440)
items.text: The list continues its cell: no line between them, no shadow, as wide as the cell (193 / 193px; was 224 / 193). The options are rows edge to edge (no inset; was 9px), the hovered one tinted; sharp boxes, the ticked one filled with a tick.

items.text: A frame of the entrance: the cards on the screen rise one after another, 90ms apart (measured: when the first is at 68% opacity the second is at 10%; the fourth lands about 0.35s after the first).

items.title: The footer under the home's facts (1440)

items.text: The same drag, 130px across: before, nothing; now the pack turns with the hand (0.012 rad a pixel) and tilts with it (0.006 a pixel, at most 0.6); let go, it turns back to the scroll's angle.

items.title: «Кофе с похожим вкусом» (1440)

items.title: The team (1440)

items.title: The team (390)
items.text: Two columns on a phone.

items.ask: The 2 small text blocks should be aligned at the top (see figma). The first one should drop «ближайшей»
items.done: The tops of their words are level at every size (0px apart at most over the 25 screens; before up to 48px, because below M they stood one under the other). Below M, as in Figma's 390 frame, two columns with the icon above the words; from M one row with the icons before them. «До обжарки менее N часов» (and «До обжарки меньше часа»).

items.ask: Default tab text color — 30%. It should be vertically trimmed
items.done: Inactive tabs ink 30% (new token --c-ink-30), the current one ink. text-box: trim-both cap alphabetic: a tab's box is its capitals plus 6px above and below (45px at 1440, was 63px; 35 at 390, was 46), so the row is as tall as its letters. 30% is 1.7 : 1 on white, under the 3 : 1 of large text: an exception (decision tabs-30).

items.ask: Chevron 30% opacity
items.done: The chevron of every menu cell (the filters and the buy bar) at opacity 0.3 of the text's colour.

items.ask: «Цена за 200 г» → «Цена»
items.done: The caption says «Цена»; for a screen reader the list is still «Цена за 200 г, ₽» (the filter is on the 200 g price).

items.ask: A filter should extend into its menu (they will look like a single element)
items.done: The list hangs from the cell's foot with no line between them (its line on the sides and the far end only) and no shadow, as wide as the cell: 193 / 193px at 1440 (was 224 / 193, wider than the cell, with a shadow). A cell narrower than 10.5rem would make its list wider; no filter cell is.

items.ask: Filters should have fill on hover. Also square checkboxes, no space between menu items and on the sides of them
items.done: Hovered, a cell and each option fill with the ground's tint (ink 6% on white). Checkboxes are the site's sharp box (as in the checkout), ticked: filled with a tick; the sort's radios are dots. The options are rows edge to edge: no padding in the list, no gap, 16px inside a row (the cell's own text inset).

items.ask: Cards should appear one after another
items.done: They rise into place (opacity 0.6s, 1 screen-gap up 0.9s, --ease-out), 90ms apart in reading order: those on the screen when the page opens, then each as it comes onto the screen, and the shown ones again after a filter changes. The 3D packs fade and rise with their cards. Not with «reduce motion», not when coming back (Back), and without scripts they simply stand (decision catalog-rise).

items.ask: Photos should be used only for special coffee
items.done: Only a Special coffee may show a photo (photoOf in components.mjs, used by every card, the bag, favourites and purchases). q-berry and Эфиопия Бекеле (Classic) show their packs now.

items.ask: Use photos in the second card (it should be special)
items.done: The second card in the default order is Вьетнам Куа Мон (Special, tagged «Новинка»); it now has a photo (the moodboard box photo, a placeholder). Three Special coffees show photos.

items.ask: Footer should use no border. This is a general rule for cases when the section above doesn't have borders touching the footer
items.done: The footer has no line above it on any page. Measured on all 20 pages, only the home page's facts have lines (the hairlines between their cells) that run down to the footer: the facts now close themselves with a hairline the screen wide (decision footer-no-line).

items.ask: The pack is lagging behind scroll
items.done: Two causes, both gone. The turn eased towards the scroll's angle at 5 per second (about 0.2s behind); it now is the scroll's angle in the same frame (measured two frames after a jump of 400, 900, 1600 and 2400px: 0 rad apart; before 0.93, 1.73, 2.73 and 3.51 rad behind). And the 3D canvas stood on the page, so a scroll carried the pinned pack for a frame before it was drawn again: while the pack is pinned the canvas is now fixed to the screen (stage.fixed), and goes back onto the page as the pin lets go.

items.ask: The pack should be draggable. When you release the cursor, it should go to the initial angle
items.done: Drag across the pack to turn it (0.012 rad a pixel), down to tilt it (0.006 a pixel, at most 0.6 rad); the cursor is a hand. Let go, it turns back to the angle of the scroll (5 per second: 95% in 0.6s; measured 1.45 → −0.35 rad in about 1.2s). On a touch screen a drag across turns it and up or down still scrolls the page (touch-action: pan-y). The press-to-push-away of the cards is not on the big pack.

items.ask: Selectors should match the style of the filters
items.done: The options (grind, roast, weight) are the same menu cells as the filters (one component: blocks.mjs menu), their lists opening upwards; the choice is a radio, and «В корзину» records it as before.

items.ask: The grey container of the selectors should be black and should not have the top border
items.done: Read as «not»: the bar is black (data-tone black: white text, white 30% lines, white 20% hover), with no line above it; «В корзину» is white with black letters.

items.ask: «КОФЕ С ПОХОЖИМ ВКУСОМ» should have the same space below, as it is above
items.done: Below the heading --section-y, as above it: 118 / 119px at 1440 (was 65 below), 60 / 61 at 390 (was 42).

items.ask: For the people (their number and info) use the attached picture
items.done: Fourteen people, names and roles word for word in the picture's order (Юра's «сорс» too — say if it should read «сорсинг»; two Ильи, by their roles). The portraits are still the seven stock photos, repeated; the picture's illustrations could replace them — say if you want that.

blocks.title: What this changes that you may not expect
items: The inactive tabs are now below every contrast ratio of the site (1.7 : 1): decision tabs-30.
The buy bar's options are no longer native selects: on a phone they open the site's list instead of the system's wheel.
Jumping far down the catalog (End, a reload that keeps its place) leaves the cards passed over waiting below: they rise as you scroll back to them.
While a card rises (0.9s) it is a stacking context, so its pack draws above its name, as in the recommended row.
On the product page, while the pack is pinned, the cards of «Кофе с похожим вкусом» further down are drawn by a canvas that stands on the screen; they are off the screen then.
q-berry and Эфиопия Бекеле lost their photos everywhere (cards, the bag, favourites, purchases), not only in the catalog.

sections.title: The system
sections.sub: design/scale.json: one range (320 → 1440), one ladder, roles with two ends. build/tokens.mjs writes one clamp() per role and checks the rules.

blocks.title: The ladder
blocks.sub: Steps of 2 up to 24, of 4 up to 64, of 8 up to 128, of 16 up to 256. Every end of every role sits on it (dots).

sections.sub: Every measure your round 7 comments asked for, on round 6's build and on this one, at phones upright and sideways, tablets, short and tall laptops, 1920 and 2560. The sections after it describe each area as it works now.

blocks.title: Round 7's measures at 25 screens
blocks.sub: Round 6 (main) struck, this round after it. Info: the tops of the two blocks' words (px apart) and how each stands. Tab: an inactive tab's colour, its box / its text's line box. List: an open filter's list / its cell (width), the line between them, the options' inset. Bar: the buy bar's height and its options. Similar: the room above / below the heading. sections.title: The fades
sections.sub: Every gradient of the site is one of these five (design/colors.json fades → build/tokens.mjs → --fade-<place>), laid over the whole block it stands under, never over a solid band (build/rules.mjs). Round 6: one curve for all, 0.5, 0, 0.5, 1 (your pick in the fade tuner; was «ease» 0.25, 0.1, 0.25, 1), and the new place «top».

sections.title: The navbar and the tab bar
sections.sub: Round 2 built it (four steps, the colours of the section under it, one max width with the column, a tab bar on phones); round 5 put the sections in one row; round 6 made every link an even cell 8px from the next (so the full row starts at 70em), made the home logo a button and designed the menu. The table is round 2's measure, round 1 struck; round 6's nav column is in «Round 6 areas».

items.title: Steps
items.html: Every section in one row from 70em (1120: its eight cells need 708px; round 6, was 64em); «Каталог, Бизнесу, Журнал, Контакты» from 48em (768, the screen of M); the burger below; under 40em (640) the tab bar. In em, so bigger browser text takes the narrower step sooner. media.css: --links-full, --links, --phone.

items.title: Width
items.html: The bar's margin is 16px (the small gutter); its content min(100% − 2 × (16 − 8), --col-max + 2 × 8): the logo's and icons' boxes carry 8px of air, so the glyphs stand 16px from the edges, and on the column's edges once it is at its most (1616 and up).

items.title: Grounds
items.html: Sections say data-ground (paper, cloud, black, ink); it sets --g-bg, --g-fg, --line and --tint. The bar takes a ground once its whole height is over that section, crossing over in 0.6s; at the top of the page (and above it) the first section's. The tab bar does the same at the foot of the screen.

items.title: Hover
items.html: A tint behind the one item: --tint, white 20% on dark grounds, ink 6% on light ones. 0.2s in, 0.45s out. Nothing else on the bar changes. A link is a 40px cell with 14px each side of its text (about its 13px over the capitals and 15 under the baseline), the cells 8px apart (round 6): the ground is the cell, so two never touch. On the home page the logo is a button to the top, with no hover.

items.title: Links
items.html: An item links only to a page that exists (data/site.json nav: a second value is the path). Today: «Кофе» and «Каталог». The rest are <a> without href: shown, not clickable, not in the tab order.

items.title: Menu (round 6)
items.html: Under 48em the burger opens every section in cells: lines across the whole menu, the gutter on all four sides of each trimmed text, no line under the last cells; two columns from 40em (a tablet); it slides down from under the bar (0.6s). Decision mobile-menu.

items.title: Tab bar
items.html: 56px + the safe area, four equal cells with icon and label (--type-small); the bag's count only. Everything fixed to the foot stands on it through --tabbar-h (the buy bar, the toast, the menu's height, the hero).

blocks.title: The navbar at 25 screens
blocks.sub: Step: what the bar shows. Icons: the tools in the bar. Logo / icon: how far the logo glyph and the last icon glyph stand inside the content column's edges (negative: outside it, in the gutter).

sections.title: The hero
sections.sub: The first screen of the home page. Round 6: the title on the ladder (48 → 88), the cells that own their padding and reach the screen's edges, new layouts below L and below M, the note over the whole cell, QQ Digits, an entrance part by part. Round 6's measures are in «Round 6 areas»; the table here is round 2's.

items.title: Height
items.html: min(100svh − 24 − tab bar, --hero-max), never less than its parts: from L the navbar + --hero-photo (48 → 120) + --hero-fade (64 → 160) + the cells; below L the title, the photo between and the dock. --hero-max 960 → 1200 (decision hero-height).

items.title: Layouts
items.html: Below M: the title at the top, the dock at the photo's foot in two columns sharing three rows (the day and the time beside «Каталог», the digits beside «Бизнесу», the caption beside «Контакты»). M → L: the dock in two rows, the countdown's parts side by side over the three links (shared columns). From L: one row of three cells, the title first. Row padding --hero-cell-y 12 → 20; texts trimmed to cap height and baseline.

items.title: Cells and padding
items.html: Below the max the cells reach over the gutters (--bleed) to the screen's edges, so their hairlines run out by themselves, and each cell is padded by the gutter on both sides: its text starts on the column, and no padding of a higher box shows (round 6). From the max (the column at 1520, or a 1616px screen: --framed) they stay on the column inside a frame.

items.title: Title
items.html: --type-hero 48 → 88 (on the ladder; round 6). Below L at that size, at most two words a line, at the top over a fade from the navbar (fades.top). From L it fills its cell, «обжарки» (4.55em) from padding to padding, between 48 and --type-hero: 58px at 1024, 84 at 1440, 88 from about 1540; its three lines and the gutter above and below set the cells' height (decision hero-title-fills-cell).

items.title: Countdown
items.html: QQ Digits drawn as SVG segments (build/digits.mjs from design/digits.json; decision qq-digits), «00:00:00» 3em wide: as wide as the caption (13.9em of --type-control) or as its cell where the caption takes two lines; the trace at 12%; a segment fades on in 120ms, off in 200ms. More than 24h to wait shows the date in mono. The «i» lays its note over the whole cell, centred, the cell keeping its height.

items.title: Fades and entrance
items.html: --fade-hero under the cells with its lead-in (from L under the whole row, below L under the dock) and --fade-top under the title below L, both on 0.5, 0, 0.5, 1. Opening, the dock rises over 1.4s (--t-intro), and its cells arrive part by part: the title line by line (GSAP SplitText), the countdown row by row, the links one by one (decision hero-entrance).

blocks.title: The hero at 25 screens
blocks.sub: Before (struck) and now. Peek: what shows of the next block under the hero, above the tab bar (negative: taller than the screen). Lines: the title. Digits / caption: their drawn widths. Align: the largest distance between a link's centre and its countdown part's (from M).

sections.title: New arrivals
sections.sub: One coffee at a time: a text square and a photo square, the pager in the middle of the head. New in round 3.

items.title: Halves
items.html: From L two tracks of minmax(0, 1fr), both aspect-ratio: 1; below L the text above the photo. The text square never grows: scripts/slider.js cuts the story to the whole lines that fit between the name and the taste box (--lines, at most 8).

items.title: Photo
items.html: The coffee's own photo, else the next of featured.photos (four moodboard photos, placeholder); its line over the eased black fade. No hairline beside it.

items.title: Head
items.html: From M three columns 1fr auto 1fr: title, pager, arrows; the pager is in the head's middle wherever the title and arrows are. Below M the pager has its own row.

items.title: Taste box
items.html: The chart's cell has at its sides the air its rows have above them, 12px + (1.75em − 1cap) / 2 (round 5), and stands in its middle when the pills are taller. The taste chart and the pills in two equal halves from M (minmax(min-content, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr): the chart never shrinks, so on 1000–1030 screens its half is up to 12px wider); below M the chart over the pills.

items.title: Link
items.html: The name's link stretched over the slide (::after, z-index 6); the caption above it lets clicks through.

items.title: Swipe and hover
items.html: Still the ordinary scroll-snap row (a magazine-like turn is being chosen in the test bench). The photo no longer zooms on hover; the pager's numbers and the arrows tint their cell (round 5).

blocks.title: New arrivals at 25 screens
blocks.sub: Text / photo: the widths of the two halves (one above the other below L). Heights: text / photo. Taste box: its two cells. Pager: its centre off the head's. Lines: the story's whole lines.

sections.title: The recommended row and the card
sections.sub: The row runs to the screen's edges, but since round 5 its cards show only inside the column: they rise in and sink away. A card is one link; its cells and heart tint on hover.

items.title: Bleed
items.html: The row is widened by the column's margins and padded back (--bleed-l, --bleed-r, measured from the column by script), with scroll-padding the same: its cards stand and snap on the column, but slide out to the screen's edges. Without the script it is the column.

items.title: In the column only
items.html: Out of the column a card waits --section-gap below and clear ([data-wait]). Half in, it rises over --t-rise and fades in over --t-move, the first ones 90ms apart; as soon as it starts crossing out it sinks away over --t-out ([data-wait=out]). On a phone the peeking card counts as in. Not with «reduce motion».

items.title: Packs
items.html: A pack stands exactly in its slot while the page scrolls or the row slides (round 5: no lag, no turn). A card rising into place carries its pack up: it trails and tilts, carryTilt 0.45 at the full trail (12% of its height, ≤ 40px); a card sinking away takes it down upright. A press anywhere on the card moves it away.

items.title: One link
items.html: The name's link is stretched over .card; the picture's layers (photo, pack, name, buy row) share one grid cell, so nothing between is positioned. The heart and the buy row sit above it at z-index 7.

items.title: Hovers
items.html: The weights cell, the price button and the heart tint their ground (--tint: ink 6%, white 20% on a photo card); nothing fades or zooms (round 5). The weights are one cell: a click anywhere picks the other weight.

items.title: Fade
items.html: The buy row is one fade over its whole height (--fade-card-cloud / -black), its 56px lead-in letting clicks through to the card's link.

blocks.title: The recommended row and the info modal at 25 screens
blocks.sub: Row: its width against the column (it runs to the screen's edges now). First card: its left edge off the column's. Modal: the opened box (width × height; a sheet on a phone).

sections.title: The info blocks and their modal
sections.sub: Three blocks that grow into one modal (Figma info-blocks-modal). Round 5: bigger icons, the plus in the corner, the modal grows as one card.

items.title: Blocks
items.html: Three buttons divided by hairlines (no line above them): the icon (--fact-icon 40 → 56), the title, the ringed plus (32px) 12px in from the corner. Stacked below M, the lines between them run to the screen's edges. Hover: the tint of the ground.

items.title: Modal
items.html: One <dialog> (focus held inside, Esc closes, focus back on its block): a box of --modal-w (360 → 520) over ink 20%; under 40em a sheet at the foot, as wide as the screen. Icon, title (the block's size), the text, the cross; «‹ prev | next ›» step to the other blocks.

items.title: Growing
items.html: One card (round 5): the box starts on the block, cut to its size (clip-path), and grows into place; the icon and title travel at their size, the text rides with the title fading in, the step row slides up from the card's foot, the plus turns 45° into the cross. 0.6s on --ease-out; back the same way. Every box is measured before anything moves.

items.title: Stepping

items.title: Pin

items.title: Pack

items.title: By hand (round 7)
items.html: Drag across it to turn it (0.012 rad/px), down to tilt it (0.006 rad/px, ≤ 0.6); let go, it turns back to the scroll's angle at 5/s. The stage hears the pointer (the tiles scroll over the pin) and checks it is over the pack, not a tile; touch-action: pan-y keeps a vertical swipe a scroll (decision pack-drag).

items.title: Canvas on the screen (round 7)
items.html: While the pack is pinned (progress < 1) the one 3D canvas is position: fixed (stage.fixed), placed where its band of the page would be; otherwise it stands on the page. So neither the pinned pack nor the cards ride a scroll for the frame before they are drawn again.

items.title: Arriving from a card (round 3)

items.title: Buy bar

items.title: In fast, out slow
items.html: Hovers come in at 0.2s and leave at 0.45s, so a pointer passing over a list leaves a soft trail (as Flow Medium).

items.title: Two loops
items.html: The hero photo drifts 8% over 40s and back; the footer flame burns in 5s (round 3). Both stop with «reduce motion» (the flame shows its first frame).

items.title: Shared elements (round 3)
items.html: Things that belong together travel instead of appearing: a block becomes its modal (its icon, title and plus move; the ground grows), a card becomes its page (name and pack move). Nothing text-bearing is scaled except the name in the page transition, which the browser grows from one size to the other.

items.title: Still (round 5)
items.html: The page's scroll and a sliding row never move or tilt a pack; only a card rising into place carries its pack, which tilts and settles. Hovers never move anything either: they tint.

items.title: Weight
items.html: Pressed anywhere on its card, a pack gives way (further, smaller) and stays while held.

items.title: Dealt (round 7)
items.html: The catalog's cards arrive one after another as they come onto the screen, as the recommended row's do; a change of the filters deals them again.

items.title: In the hand (round 7)
items.html: The big pack is the scroll's exactly; a drag turns it on top of that, and it springs back when let go. Nothing about it trails the scroll.

items.title: Part by part (round 6)
items.html: The hero arrives the way it is read: the block first, then inside each cell its parts in order (the title's lines, the countdown's rows, the links), each starting when the one before is a third of the way, all on --ease-out. Any input ends it; with «reduce motion» there is none.

items.title: Colour crossings
items.html: The bars change colour only when wholly over a section, on the travel curve and time, so a boundary never flickers through them.

sections.title: The grammar
sections.sub: How the site is drawn, in plain words, and which of these rules a script checks.

items.title: Colour
items.html: Ink #2d2f33 on paper, cloud #f6f6f6 for surfaces (cards, tiles, the buy bar), graphite and black for dark blocks, lavender for eyebrows and info icons. Secondary text is ink at 70% (--g-soft: white 80% on dark grounds); 60% only for large text; 30% only for the catalog's inactive tabs (round 7). Every section names its ground; lines and hover tints follow it: ink 20% / white 30%, ink 6% / white 20%.

items.title: Type
items.html: Mono bold capitals tracked 0.05em for names and headings; Apercu for everything read; QQ Digits (seven-segment SVG, a 12% trace) for the countdown. Labels (eyebrows, controls, prices) differ by case and colour, not size.

items.title: Size
items.html: Every size a line from 320 to 1440 on one ladder; the screen's height counts; nothing grows past 1440, the column stops at 1520.

items.title: Shape
items.html: Sharp rectangles divided by hairlines; only pills and dots are round.

items.title: Layout
items.html: Everything sits in the content column; full-bleed blocks put their content in a column too, so they change at the same steps S, M, L.

items.title: Motion
items.html: Three curves, four times, two loops; things that belong together travel (a block becomes its modal as one card); hovers tint and never move; packs move only when their card rises.

blocks.title: Rules
rows: Sizes only from the scale; screen units only where a decision says
Layout steps only at S, M, L, max (and 70em, 48em, 40em, 32em tall, 1616px framed)
No rounded corners except pills and dots
Type levels ≥ ×1.125 apart at both ends
One line colour: borders only var(--line)
The navbar's sections never touch the logo or the tools (audit)
The countdown as wide as its caption (audit)
Every fade eased and whole: one var(--fade-*) per place, over the whole block, no solid band under it (rounds 3, 5)
Hovers never move: no transform in a :hover rule (round 5)
Lines run out to the screen's edges beside the column, or stop at its frame (round 5)
A cell's padding is its own: the hero's cells reach the screen's edges and are padded by the gutter on both sides (round 6)
Every rule of the container step max is repeated under the page condition --framed (round 6)
The countdown's drawing lives in design/digits.json, never in the SVG (round 6)
A state border may be ink or ink 50% (the pager's ring, round 6)
A pointer's focus changes nothing; scripts move focus through focusFrom() (round 5)
A whole card is its link; nothing positioned between the link and .card (round 3)
Things that belong together travel (block → modal, card → page) (round 3)
Waiting cards are data-wait; data-out is the filter's (round 3)
Links only to pages that exist
Fixed bars stand on the tab bar (--tabbar-h)
A hover tints only its own item's ground
Every row that scrolls sideways is position: relative
3D canvas at z-index 5; what shows above packs ≥ 6
Links inside the site through href(ctx, to)
One heading level per section; names in mono, text in Apercu
Cells inside a block share hairlines (margin −1px), never double lines
One menu cell (blocks.mjs menu) for every choice from a list: the filters and the buy bar (round 7)
Only Special coffees show photos (photoOf, round 7)
No line above the footer; a section whose lines reach it closes itself (round 7)

blocks.title: The independent review
blocks.sub: A separate agent that had not seen the round checked the built site against your comments and the rules, in a browser (phones, tablet, laptop, wide; the keyboard; «reduce motion»; Back). Its findings and what was done about each:
items: Bug: after a filter change the cards' 3D packs stayed invisible until the page scrolled (alpha 0.00 at 4.2s, 3 runs of 3). fixed A pack being carried by its rising card now keeps the canvas drawing (packs.js); measured after ticking Classic: 0.99 at 0.4s, 1.00 from 1.2s.

Bug: Back from a coffee to the catalog no longer carried the card's name and pack (every card was rendered waiting, and vt.js skips waiting cards). fixed A card counts as waiting only while it is hidden: in a rising reel, or in the catalog under html[data-enter], which is never set on Back.

Bug (keyboard): an arrow key in the product's options closed the list and dropped the focus to the page. fixed Only a pointer's choice closes the list; arrows move the choice (the cell shows it at once), Enter or Escape close it with the focus back on the cell (focusFrom). Measured: ArrowDown → open, «1 кг», shown in the cell; Enter → closed, focus on the summary.

At 844 × 390 the upward lists opened off the top of the screen (the bar waits after the stage there, so it can stand under the navbar). fixed A list with no room above it opens down (data-down): 121–298 on the screen.

If the page's module failed to load, the catalog's cards stayed hidden. fixed As the hero's entrance does, a CSS failsafe shows waiting cards after --t-wait (3s) unless the script has taken the grid (data-dealing); measured with the module blocked: opacity 0 at 1s, 1 at 4s.

A long drag unwound every turn on release, and grabbing the pack on its way back made it jump. fixed Let go, the hand's turn is wrapped to the nearest angle (a 1000px drag: 11.65 → −0.69 → settles at −0.35 rad, under a turn); caught on its way back, it is held where it is.

«Кофе с похожим вкусом»: the visible gap from the story's last line to the heading is 235px, not 118. kept The story is on the cloud ground and the similar coffees on white, so the edge between the grounds is what reads as «above»: 118px from it to the heading, 119 from the heading to the cards. Said in the report; Tim can say if he meant the 235.

Smaller notes. fixed the about text claimed each photo twice (they repeat unevenly, matched by who they show: now said so); the new arrivals read photos through photoOf too; Escape uses focusFrom. Not changed: the team grid ends with 2 of 4 cells (14 people); the bag's lines keep native selects (not asked; a question for Tim); the report was still being written when the review ran.
